periods.summaryTitle: Refined abilities and updated user experience

features: Added initial gameplay tutorial (FTUE) to guide new players through the game's systems.
Improved overall UI presentation and incorporated additional lore into the character experience.
bugfixes: Resolved an issue where amulets slots were not displaying correctly.
Fixed a bug impacting the force field skill functionality across various combat scenarios.
balance: Refined several spells and character specializations (specs) for better gameplay balance.
ux: Overhauled the User Experience, adding lore elements and improving UI flows.
Addressed various UI bugs to smooth out the player's overall interaction with the game.
